title: Driftkings
author: Driftkings
changelog: Migrate High Caliber progress to Gameface with the original medal, configurable positioning and a dynamic progress bar.
Separate arcade, postmortem and artillery camera profiles; preserve native artillery camera values by default.
Use the client realm and active language for player-panel region and destruction macros.
Remove retired clock and target-acquisition configuration defaults while preserving personal settings.
Pin updater downloads to the official repository and verify Ed25519-signed release manifests.
Add portable regression tests and refresh the build reference to WoT source 2.4.1.5493; retain the recorded SWC export provenance.
Beta: in-game validation of the signed update flow and all affected camera modes is still required.
